### Get Behind Me, Sluggard: Four Lessons Against Laziness
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/get-behind-me-sluggard
Passage: Proverbs 24:30-34
Points:
- Small compromises and little delays accumulate into significant loss and ruin over time.
- Inaction is never neutral; neglecting daily duties actively cultivates practical and spiritual thorns.
- Deceptive impulses promise easy comfort while quietly stripping away long-term joy and peace.
- Diligence is more than self-discipline; it flows from a heart awake to the presence and lordship of Christ.
